proof: For integers a=qb+r, a common divisor of a,b divides r; a common divisor of b,r divides a. Thus gcd is preserved. The last nonzero remainder is 6. An aligned uniform square grid must have side dividing both integer lengths; even allowing real side lengths the final 6-wide strip bounds the maximum, and 6 is attained.
limits: Numerical checks supplement the stated general proof. No audience learning is inferred.
